mentions.name: CodeLens
mentions.description: An open-source AI code reviewer that combines AI-powered review with static analysis in one place. Supports multiple LLMs (Ollama for local runs, Claude, and Gemini), integrates with GitHub and GitLab via webhooks, includes a developer pulse and leaderboard to gamify reviews, and provides LLM cost monitoring to avoid surprise bills.
